items.spec: input >= 60 V with the GL40 (open-circuit freewheel 35.2 V at 2.5 m/s, the towing state); >= 100 V if the GM4108H is used (82.8 V); buck-boost because the 1.0 m/s optimum is ~4.55 V; current limit so the winding copper loss stays at the rated 11.81 W (DC side 1.62 A block model / 1.715 A time-domain). No continuous phase-short brake (it would put 69.6 W into the windings at 2.5 m/s). Optional dump load 10.02 ohm across the DC link (29.47 W at 2.5 m/s; rate >= 2x)
items.note: electronics are out of scope for v1
